# Runway expression portraits — final prompts

Built-in image_gen tool. These four files are saved alongside this manifest as reaction-s-v1.png, reaction-a-v1.png, reaction-b-v1.png, reaction-c-v1.png. The input reference is parts-base-v1.png, the same fictional adult character. Original generated files remain in the Codex image library.

## S

Use case: identity-preserve. Edit target: the same fictional 24-year-old Korean woman in the provided SEOUL STUDIO illustration. Asset type: runway results character expression portrait, grade S. Primary request: A bright delighted beaming smile, laughing softly with teeth visible and eyes sparkling. Proud joyful excitement after a perfect runway styling. Tight head-and-shoulders portrait, same original face identity, same long brown hair, skin tone and realistic 3D CGI illustration style. Wear a plain ivory crewneck blouse. Centered, face large, entire head including hair top visible, shoulders at bottom. Soft flattering studio light. True transparent alpha background, no glow, no scene, no text, no grade lettering, no logo, no props, no other people. This is an expressive game result image; keep adult proportions, original character identity and non-pixel realism.
